_meta.note: Feasibility ground truth for Shiny and Shadow/Purified Pokedex categories. These are large, constantly-changing datasets (Niantic adds new shinies and Rocket-encounterable Shadow species on an ongoing basis) that this project has no authoritative feed for, so per the build brief this file does NOT attempt full coverage. It seeds a small, high-confidence set of species that have been stable/unambiguous for years, and leaves everything else null (unknown) rather than guessing. shinyReleased/shadowAvailable only ever carry `true` here (see rationale below) -- absence of a key means 'unknown', not 'false'. Consumers (medaldexEngine.isCategoryFeasible) fall back to `defaults` for any speciesId not listed. Purified feasibility is derived from shadowAvailable (a species can only be Purified if it can be Shadow), so there is no separate purifiedAvailable map.
_meta.whyNoFalseEntries: Shiny releases are permanent once live and Shadow-availability additions are also one-directional in practice, so a `true` claim, once correct, stays correct forever. A `false` claim ('not yet released') has no such guarantee -- it can flip to true at any future Community Day/event, and this file has no live feed to keep it current, so a stale `false` would actively mislead a player. Marking those `null` (honestly 'unknown, needs data') instead of `false` was a deliberate accuracy-over-completeness tradeoff called out in the build brief ('never fake data you don't have').
sources: General, long-stable Pokemon GO knowledge as of this project's build date -- Gen 1 starter lines, Pikachu/Eevee lines, and other Pokemon whose Shiny form has been live since 2018-2019 or earlier; and the classic 2019-era Team GO Rocket grunt roster (Zubat/Rattata/Geodude/Drowzee/Gastly/Koffing/Magikarp lines) whose Shadow availability has been stable for years.

Not sourced from a datamine or API -- this is a curated seed, intentionally conservative. See MedalDex build report for the explicit list of what was NOT modeled (most Gen 4+ shinies, most legendary/mythical Shadow availability, event-exclusive shinies).
